instances.tcp_mss_enabled_hint: Fragment ClientHello packets to defeat DPI reassembly. Requires iptables on the host.
instances.tcp_mss_hint: Client MSS (88-4096). Lower = more fragmentation, defeats segment-boundary DPI (88=extreme-low, 92=tspu, 256=2in8). Raises pps. Linux only. Restarts the instance.
instances.client_mss_bulk_hint: 0 = off. Raise MSS to this value after the TLS handshake to cut pps while keeping the low handshake MSS (e.g. 1400). Pairs with tspu.
instances.unknown_sni_action_hint: What to do with a TLS ClientHello whose SNI is not one of the configured domains. reject_handshake mimics nginx ssl_reject_handshake. Changing this restarts the instance.
instances.tls_fronting_hint: Auto-download and serve the TLS domain's website to defend against active probing. Requires FakeTLS.
instances.reload_all_hint: Reload config for all running instances

traffic-flush.name: Traffic Flush
traffic-flush.description: Scrapes traffic metrics from the telemt engine and writes them to the database.

quota-check.name: Quota Check
quota-check.description: Checks user traffic quotas and disables secrets that exceed their limits.

expiry-check.name: Expiry Check
expiry-check.description: Checks secret expiration dates and disables expired secrets.

health-check.name: Health Check
health-check.description: Verifies the telemt engine container is running and restarts it if necessary.

telegram-report.name: Telegram Report
telegram-report.description: Sends periodic traffic and status reports via the configured Telegram bot.

replication-sync.name: Replication Sync
replication-sync.description: Synchronizes configuration and data to configured slave servers via SSH.

update-check.name: Update Check
update-check.description: Checks for new PopuGate releases and notifies via the Telegram bot.

auto-update.name: Auto-Update
auto-update.description: Checks for new PopuGate releases, installs them and restarts the service automatically.

telemt-check.name: Engine Version Check
telemt-check.description: Checks for new telemt engine versions and updates the Docker image.

docker-host-check.name: Docker Host Update Check
docker-host-check.description: Checks for new host Docker Engine releases and notifies via the Telegram bot.

token-cleanup.name: Token Cleanup
token-cleanup.description: Removes expired and revoked JWT tokens from the blocklist.

daily-backup.name: Daily Backup
daily-backup.description: Creates an encrypted backup of the database and configuration files.

backup-cleanup.name: Backup Cleanup
backup-cleanup.description: Removes old backups that exceed the configured retention period.

history-cleanup.name: History Cleanup
history-cleanup.description: Deletes scheduler execution history records older than 7 days.

quota-reset.name: Monthly Quota Reset
quota-reset.description: Resets all user traffic quotas to zero at the start of each month.
quota-reset.warning: Enabling this will reset all traffic counters every month. Users will lose their current quota usage data.

auto-rotate.name: Auto Key Rotation
auto-rotate.description: Automatically rotates MTProto proxy secrets that are older than the configured number of days.
auto-rotate.warning: Enabling this will change proxy keys for all users whose secrets exceed the rotation age. Users will need updated links to continue using the proxy.

upstream-health.name: Upstream Health Check
upstream-health.description: Checks connectivity and latency of configured upstream proxy servers.

fronting-update.name: Fronting Content Update
fronting-update.description: Refreshes all domain fronting configuration and content dynamically.
